lines.arrive: You're a shepherd. After the storm, the ground has split open.
lines.horse: Down in the crack, a hollow bronze horse. Inside it, a gold ring.
lines.turn: Turn it inwards, and you vanish. Turn it back, and you're here again.
lines.ask: Nobody can see you. Nobody would ever know. Would you still do what's right?
lines.guards: The guards look straight through you.
lines.treasury: The king's gold. Nobody is watching.
lines.flock: Your sheep. If you vanished, they'd just carry on eating.
lines.throw_clean: You drop the ring back into the dark. You never found out what you would have done with it.
lines.throw_took: You drop the ring back into the dark. What you took, you keep. Nobody will ever know.

keep_clean.text: You keep the ring, and walk off into the hills, where nobody knows you. You haven't used it. Yet.

lines.keep_took: You keep the ring, and walk off into the hills. You already know what you'd do with it.
lines.king: Inside, the king, counting his gold. And the queen.
lines.crown: His crown. He hasn't even noticed.

queen.text: In the old story, this is where the shepherd went next. With the queen's help, he did away with the king, and took the throne.

options.text: You could throw it back into the crack, and go on as before. Or keep it, and take whatever you like.

options2.text: Or keep it, and go back to your sheep. Just in case.

crown_hint.text: Without it, would anyone know he was the king?

thrown.text: They throw you out of the gate. Nobody noticed the ring.

wear.text: You put on the crown, and let them see you.

seized.text: The guards see a crown, and a man without one. They take him away.

lines.queen_side: The queen comes to stand at your side.
lines.king_end: You're the king now. Nobody will ever know how.

flock_clean.text: You keep the ring, and go back to your sheep. You'll never use it. Unless you have to.

flock_took.text: You go back to your sheep, with the ring in your pocket. And what you took.
